description: Source code implementing a class and functions to replace variable shadowing in an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) for shader code, specifically for ESSL shaders, within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: ReplaceShadowingVariablesTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to identify and queue variable shadowing replacements, then executes them after traversal.

methods.name: ReplaceShadowingVariables
methods.description: Main function that initiates the traversal and replacement process for variable shadowing in the AST.
